# OA v0.7.32

**Status:** Public development preview

**Release date:** 2026-08-31

**Source:** [`v0.7.32`](https://github.com/realminc/oa/releases/tag/v0.7.32)

## Summary

OA v0.7.32 is the immutable hosted-release repair for `v0.7.31`. Runtime
implementation and public APIs are unchanged. The sanitizer workflow now
builds a CMake aggregate derived mechanically from the registered `core` CTest
profile, closing the mismatch that left `TestAnimation` registered but absent
from both sanitizer build trees. This patch also publishes the current Viewer
presentation captures and their source-owned manifest/catalog metadata.

OA remains a pre-1.0 development preview rather than a stable source or binary
contract.

## Fixed

- Add the `oa_host_core_tests` aggregate, derived from every executable-backed
  CTest carrying the `core` label.
- Make ASAN/LSAN and UBSAN build that aggregate before executing `ctest -L
  core`, eliminating the duplicated hand-maintained target list.
- Include `TestAnimation` in both hosted sanitizer profiles without weakening
  labels, skip policy, sanitizer options, or test timeouts.

## Documentation and presentation evidence

- Add current Viewer captures for image/video canvas and full-space modes.
- Add synchronized audio waveform, spectrum, and mel Viewer captures.
- Add a bounded 1280x720, 30 fps, H.264 High/yuv420p Viewer demonstration clip.
- Remove obsolete presentation captures and update the asset manifest,
  generated example catalog, and generator regression tests together.

The captures demonstrate the presentation surface; they are not substitutes
for rendering correctness, synchronization, codec conformance, or performance
evidence.

## Verification

| Gate | Result | Evidence scope |
|---|---|---|
| ASAN/LSAN core profile | Pass | 21/21 tests, including `TestAnimation`; leak detection, strict strings, halt-on-error |
| UBSAN core profile | Pass | 21/21 tests, including `TestAnimation`; halt-on-error |
| CMake aggregate | Pass | All 19 executable-backed `core` tests discovered from CTest labels |
| Viewer assets | Pass | Manifest hashes, sizes, licenses, generated catalogs, JPEG/MP4 metadata |
| Architecture and generation | Pass | Dependency policy, generator tests, and generated-source drift gate |
| Complete hosted release | Pending | Tagged build, sanitizer, package, wheel, assets, checksums, release, and PyPI workflow |

The public tagged workflow owns the complete hosted result. The `v0.7.31`
build, package, wheel, and Lavapipe jobs passed; publication was correctly
blocked because both sanitizer jobs lacked the newly registered executable.

## Compatibility and upgrade

There is no API or runtime migration from `v0.7.31`. Update to `v0.7.32` and
rebuild native and Python consumers. Applications upgrading from earlier
Viewer or animation previews should follow the migration notes in the
[`v0.7.31` release](v0.7.31.md).
